Schedules now default to unlimited failure tolerance (`-1`). Set `0` to pause on the first failure, or `N` to tolerate N failures and pause on the next. Existing values are preserved, so an existing `3` now pauses on the fourth failure. Event schedules show the recorded job's status, timing and error in Last result.

Built-in alert policies keep VPSs in scope during temporary disconnects. New webhook rules default to zero cooldown, and zero no longer suppresses late events or honors an old cooldown window. Existing webhook cooldown settings are preserved.

VPS Rules removes loading feedback after a successful load. Database migrations run automatically during the normal upgrade.
